data.gist: Conclusion: ECM-retaining micronized bone marrow improved movement-evoked pain and cartilage regeneration versus BMAC, with comparable subchondral bone effects, suggesting ECM/niche preservation may enhance cartilage repair.
data.plain: In a preclinical osteoarthritis model, a mechanically processed bone marrow preparation that keeps its native extracellular matrix worked better than standard bone marrow concentrate for pain during movement and for regrowth of damaged joint cartilage, while both affected the underlying bone similarly on imaging. The authors suggest this indicates preserving the natural matrix and stem cell niche may improve cartilage regeneration and supports developing ECM-conscious cell therapies.
